confirm_no_filter.description: You haven't set any filter (Gemeenten, Capcodes, Regios, Diensten, Melding or GRIP). This sensor will show alerts from the entire Netherlands, which can be a lot of traffic. Click Submit to continue anyway, or go back to add a filter.
